title: com.docker.sandbox/dockerd@1
description: Config schema for the Docker Engine request. Singleton; the host may refuse it. The @1 names the capability contract, including this config schema and observable behavior. RELEASES.md defines when versions move and the maintainer-approved draft-stage exception.

autoStart.description: When true (the default), the runtime starts the engine before startup hooks run. Set false to start it from the Kit's own hook; elevation and the engine store are granted either way.
